title: Oracle Essbase Database
description: An Oracle Essbase database (cube) within an application. Databases contain the multi-dimensional data model with dimensions, members, and data values. Each database has its own outline, scripts, filters, and security configuration.

name.description: Database name. Must not contain spaces.

application.description: Name of the parent application that contains this database.

owner.description: User ID of the database owner.

creationTime.description: Database creation timestamp in milliseconds since Unix epoch.

modifiedBy.description: User ID of the person who last modified the database.

modifiedTime.description: Last modification timestamp in milliseconds since Unix epoch.

status.description: Current runtime status of the database.

startTime.description: Timestamp when the database was last started, in milliseconds since Unix epoch.

description.description: Human-readable description of the database purpose.

type.description: Storage type of the database. ASO (Aggregate Storage Option) is optimized for read-heavy analytical queries. BSO (Block Storage Option) is optimized for write-heavy planning and forecasting. CURRENCY is for currency conversion databases.

applicationRole.description: The authenticated user's application role for this database.

easManagedApp.description: Whether the parent application is managed in EAS Lite (Essbase 21c independent deployment only).

startStopDBAllowed.description: Whether the user has permission to start or stop this database.

inspectDBAllowed.description: Whether the user has permission to inspect this database.

links.description: HATEOAS navigation links for related resources.

VariablesSetting.description: Settings controlling substitution variable visibility and update permissions.

showVariables.description: Whether substitution variables are visible to users.

updateVariables.description: Whether substitution variables can be updated by users.

type.description: Media type of the linked resource.
